LOOK: Photos show the aftermath of a massive fire that razed around 1,500 houses and affected 617 families in Sitio 6, Barangay Catmon, Malabon City, on Thursday, Oct. 23. 

The blaze, which broke out yesterday, quickly spread through the densely populated area, engulfing rows of homes made mostly of light materials.

📷: Santi San Juan/MB
